execution_target: Silico fair-share cluster or compatible queued environment
git_commit_policy: Launch only from the immutable commit URI delivered with this package.

prospective_amendment.timing: frozen before any Mizan model response
prospective_amendment.changed_provision: Removes a shared cross-arm status disclaimer from the system prompt and centralizes paper-claim boundaries in the claim ladder.
prospective_amendment.unchanged: Rooms, condition cues, action labels, matrix, sampling defaults, estimands, bootstrap, and failure handling.

development_smoke.promotion_gate: valid_action_rate == 1.0 and all receipts/hash checks pass

resource_profiles.local_model_inference: Replace Slurm resource directives according to the served model; retain the same task matrix and manifests.

stop_conditions: model revision or sampling parameters drift across array tasks
evaluation analysis-plan hash does not match
any condition task is missing after retry/resume
